test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Is he not driving a car?

options.text: Was he not driving a car?
Is a car not being driven by him?
Is a car not been driven by him?
Does he not drive a car?

solution:
The correct answer is:** Is a car not being driven by him?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **subject** of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **object** of the **Passive Voice**. Also, the **object** of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **subject **of the **Passive Voice**.
 
• The usage of a **helping verb** is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.
 
• The preposition** “by” **is used before the object made in Passive Voice. However, it is optional in some cases.
 
• The Active voice in this question is in **Present Continuous**. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in **Present Continuous**.
 
• The format of Active voice is: **Am/is/are + Subject + Verb (ing) + Object.**
 
• Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: **Am/is/are + Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + being + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Is a car not being driven by him?**
